note: Death and remains (DESIGN_IDEAS.md 6.1, Dave). Real seconds. Day 1 only the owner may open the remains; from day 2 anyone; the remains and what is left on them are cleaned up when gone_s has passed (day 8). The record is a position on the surface, never lost: the server puts it back on the ground when the ground under it has changed. sink_m is only a visual offset the client applies as the body decays. A character who dies is back at the spawn point after respawn_delay_s with health, food, water, energy and weight at their start values; luck, fitness and skills are kept; placed things stay. Nothing kills yet except running out of air (vitals.json breath can_die).
novice_grace_note: Novice grace (Dave 31 Oct 2026; QA card death-novice): who comes back at the spawn bed after dying and who dies for good (DESIGN_IDEAS.md 6.1). mode: 'always' = everyone respawns (the build as it was, the default); 'level' = respawn only while the character level is below `level`, then real death; 'never' = real death for everyone; 'heir' = respawn until the character has a child (children are not built, so this acts like 'always' today). character level = `metric`: 'best_skill' = the highest effective skill value on the skills page (a new character has 1; practice raises it to 100), 'skill_total' = the sum over all skills of (value - 1). Real death today: the remains are left and the character is marked final_death_pending, and the server calls send_final_death if the client flow exists; it does not exist yet, so the character still respawns (see TYLER_TEST_SYSTEM_REVIEW.md, section Death).
real_death_note: Real death build (Steve, 1 Nov 2026), OFF until Dave answers the cards death-before-heirs, death-new-start and death-downed-state. When true, a character past novice_grace who dies is marked dead, the remains stay, the server sends final_death(cause) and does NOT bring them back; the client shows the death screen (src/client/death_screen.gd), deletes the character from the machine and goes to the character select page. A dead character that logs in again gets the screen again. Off, the character comes back at the bed as before.
